intro: Kazakhstan is a presidential republic where the president holds strong powers.

chapters.title: How it works
text: President Kassym-Jomart Tokayev has led since 2019 and is now limited to a single seven-year term. Parliament has two chambers.

chapters.title: Between giants
text: Kazakhstan balances relations with Russia, China, the West and its Central Asian neighbours.

keyTerms.meaning: A system where the president leads the government.
